outcomes.residual_transfer_stronger: Local approximation is a justified next candidate, but diagnostic transfers cannot be promoted.
outcomes.full_target_transfer_stronger: Test whether learning the full map avoids irregular residual structure; do not claim a universal smoothness ordering.
outcomes.neither_stronger_than_shuffled: The chosen metric/support does not reveal useful locality; examine representation or support before fitting.
outcomes.mixed: Retain slice findings and uncertainty; do not select a temperature switch.
